lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉横着走，斑点一颠一颠。
lines.en: I cross the leaf veins sideways, spots bobbing.

lines.zh: 圆壳扣在背上，我像一颗会走的红豆。
lines.en: My round shell makes me a walking red bean.

lines.zh: 我爬上草茎，六只脚抱得紧紧的。
lines.en: I climb a grass stem with all six legs clamped.

lines.zh: 今天我先巡一遍菜畦的边。
lines.en: Today I patrol the edge of the vegetable bed.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都踩在叶上。
lines.en: I go slowly, but every step lands on a leaf.

lines.zh: 翅膀收在壳下，走路时壳轻轻响。
lines.en: Wings tucked under the shell, which taps as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶跳过那道缝，落在下一片。
lines.en: I hop the gap from this leaf to the next.

lines.zh: 壳上的七个点，走起来像在数数。
lines.en: My seven spots look like counting as I move.

lines.zh: 我绕开一只蚂蚁，它比我凶。
lines.en: I detour around an ant; it is fiercer than I am.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，红壳衬着木头很显眼。
lines.en: Along the fence my red shell stands out on the wood.

lines.zh: 露水打湿了脚，我走得慢一点。
lines.en: Dew wets my feet, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 我往花丛去，那里叶子更嫩。
lines.en: I head for the flowers where the leaves are tender.

lines.zh: 我钻过蒲公英，壳上沾了一点花粉。
lines.en: I push through a dandelion and collect pollen on my shell.

lines.zh: 我横穿小路，希望没人踩下来。
lines.en: I cross the path, hoping no one steps down.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶背，风小一点。
lines.en: I climb to the leaf's underside where the wind is less.

lines.zh: 一只蚜虫在前面，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: An aphid is ahead; I approach slowly.

lines.zh: 我把壳晒在太阳下，红得发亮。
lines.en: I sun my shell until the red glows.

lines.zh: 停在一片叶上，我慢慢搓前脚。
lines.en: Perched on a leaf, I slowly rub my front legs.

lines.zh: 露珠挂在叶尖，我盯着它看了很久。
lines.en: A dewdrop hangs at the leaf tip; I stare a long time.

lines.zh: 我不动，看着像叶子上的一个红点。
lines.en: Still as I am, I look like a red dot on the leaf.

lines.zh: 壳里的翅膀折得很整齐。
lines.en: My wings stay folded neat inside the shell.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我抱紧叶面不撒手。
lines.en: The wind blows and I cling to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根触角，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise one antenna, then let it fall.

lines.zh: 花丛里的味道很杂，我挑着闻。
lines.en: The garden smells of many things; I pick one to sniff.

lines.zh: 我缩起脚，装成一粒圆石头。
lines.en: I tuck my legs in and pass for a round pebble.

lines.zh: 壳上有一点泥，我懒得擦。
lines.en: There is mud on my shell and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我就这么趴着，等叶子长好。
lines.en: I lie here and let the leaves grow.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我才挪到另一面叶背。
lines.en: The sun shifts, so I move to the other leaf face.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我正好抬头看你。
lines.en: You crouch down and I happen to look up.

lines.zh: 我从叶背探出半个壳，打量你的手。
lines.en: I poke half my shell from the leaf and study your hands.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我停住不动。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，是蘑菇的。
lines.en: I know your smell; it is mushrooms.

lines.zh: 你在找什么，我顺着你的目光看。
lines.en: You are searching; I follow where you look.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你是一大片晃动的颜色。
lines.en: Through my compound eyes you are a swaying patch of color.

lines.zh: 我爬到你的指节上，壳烫烫的。
lines.en: I climb onto your knuckle, shell warm.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的触角跟着动。
lines.en: When you speak, my antennae move along.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你的靴尖，比我还高。
lines.en: I tilt at your boot tip, taller than I am.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我往后缩了半步。
lines.en: You reach out and I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 我在你掌心转了一圈，又爬回去。
lines.en: I circle your palm once and climb back.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候眼睛弯起来，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes curve when you laugh, and I notice.

lines.zh: 壳被踩了一下，我半天合不拢。
lines.en: A shell-crushing step, and I cannot close up for a while.

lines.zh: 我翻倒在地，六只脚在空中乱抓。
lines.en: I land on my back, six legs clawing air.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一道缝，红漆掉了。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell and the red flakes.

lines.zh: 我疼得缩成一团，一动不动。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and hold perfectly still.

lines.zh: 翅膀被扯了一下，飞不起来了。
lines.en: A wing is yanked and I can no longer fly.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿爬到叶背躲着。
lines.en: I drag a bad leg under a leaf to hide.

lines.zh: 那一下把我掀出很远。
lines.en: The blow throws me a good distance.

lines.zh: 我的斑点还在，壳却凹了。
lines.en: My spots remain, but the shell is dented.

lines.zh: 我努力走直线，但总往一边歪。
lines.en: I try to walk straight and keep veering off.

lines.zh: 有同伴爬过来，在我旁边停下。
lines.en: One of my kind climbs over and stops beside me.

lines.zh: 一朵红伞蘑菇摆在面前，我挪不动脚。
lines.en: A red-capped mushroom is set before me and my feet stop.

lines.zh: 蘑菇的味道飘过来，触角先投降。
lines.en: The mushroom smell arrives and my antennae surrender first.

lines.zh: 我围着那朵菌盖转了两圈才敢碰。
lines.en: I circle the cap twice before daring to touch.

lines.zh: 是棕蘑菇，我最没出息的那种爱好。
lines.en: It is a brown mushroom, my weakest indulgence.

lines.zh: 你捏碎菌柄，我立刻爬到你手边。
lines.en: You crush the stem and I scramble to your hand.

lines.zh: 我啃了第一口，壳都高兴得发亮。
lines.en: One bite in, my shell seems to brighten.

lines.zh: 闻到菌丝的味道，我什么也不怕了。
lines.en: Smelling the mycelium, I stop being afraid.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进菌盖，吃得满嘴都是。
lines.en: I bury my head in the cap and eat messily.

lines.zh: 那片菌褶对我来说像一床被子。
lines.en: Those gills look like a blanket to me.

lines.zh: 你手里的蘑菇一动，我的步子就乱。
lines.en: The mushroom in your hand moves and my steps falter.

lines.zh: 我用前脚抱住菌柄，怕它被抢走。
lines.en: I hug the stem with my front legs lest it be taken.

lines.zh: 只要蘑菇还在，我就赖着不走。
lines.en: As long as the mushroom lasts, I am not leaving.

lines.zh: 我撞在你鞋尖上，壳翻了个面。
lines.en: I hit your toe and my shell flips over.

lines.zh: 两只瓢虫在叶上互撞，斑碰斑。
lines.en: Two ladybugs knock on a leaf, spot against spot.

lines.zh: 我被草叶弹了一下，滚出半尺。
lines.en: A blade of grass flicks me and I roll a short way.

lines.zh: 撞上蜗牛壳，我半天没缓过来。
lines.en: I bump a snail shell and take a while to recover.

lines.zh: 壳撞在石头上，响得像小石子。
lines.en: My shell hits stone with a pebble's click.

lines.zh: 我挤过叶缝，壳被两边夹了一下。
lines.en: I squeeze through a leaf gap and my shell gets pinched.

lines.zh: 你抬手时碰到我，我飞了一小段。
lines.en: Your hand brushes me and I fly a short way.

lines.zh: 两只瓢虫抢同一片叶，撞得乱转。
lines.en: Two ladybugs fight for one leaf and spin apart.

lines.zh: 我从叶上滑下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I slip off the leaf and land shell-first.

lines.zh: 撞到蛛网边，我挣扎着退回来。
lines.en: I hit a web's edge and struggle back out.

lines.zh: 我爬到她的壳背上，斑点对着斑点。
lines.en: I climb onto her back, spot meeting spot.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一片叶走了三圈。
lines.en: We walk three circles around the same leaf.

lines.zh: 她的红比我深一点，我更喜欢了。
lines.en: Her red runs deeper than mine, which I prefer.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰她的触角，她回了一下。
lines.en: I touch antennae with her and she answers.

lines.zh: 找伴侣时，我连蘑菇都忘了。
lines.en: While courting I forget even mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我们在叶背并排趴着，谁也没动。
lines.en: We lie side by side under the leaf, neither moving.

lines.zh: 她飞起来，我马上跟上去。
lines.en: She takes flight and I follow at once.

lines.zh: 两只瓢虫在花心碰头，花粉沾了一身。
lines.en: We meet in a flower's heart, dusted with pollen.

lines.zh: 我用前脚轻轻拍了拍她的壳。
lines.en: I pat her shell lightly with my front legs.

lines.zh: 这片菜畦够大，能养我们的小虫。
lines.en: This bed is big enough to raise our grubs.

lines.zh: 你把我捏起来，我的脚在空中乱划。
lines.en: You pinch me up and my legs paddle the air.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，假装自己是个果子。
lines.en: I retract into my shell and pretend to be a berry.

lines.zh: 到了你手心，我才把脚伸出来。
lines.en: In your palm I finally stretch my legs out.

lines.zh: 被托起来时，我的壳比身体还紧张。
lines.en: Lifted, my shell is tenser than my body.

lines.zh: 你把我放到另一片叶上，我愣了愣。
lines.en: You set me on another leaf and I freeze a moment.

lines.zh: 我在你指尖上打滑，赶紧抓住。
lines.en: I slip on your fingertip and grab hold.

lines.zh: 离开菜畦，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: Out of the vegetable bed, I feel out of place.

lines.zh: 你捧我的手法很轻，我记下了。
lines.en: You hold me gently, and I take note.

lines.zh: 空中的风把我的壳吹得朝下。
lines.en: The air turns my shell face down.

lines.zh: 落回叶上，我先擦了擦脚。
lines.en: Back on a leaf, I clean my feet first.

lines.zh: 叶背爬满蚜虫，我盯住最肥那只。
lines.en: Aphids cover the leaf's underside; I fix on the fattest.

lines.zh: 有虫在啃你的番茄叶，我记下了。
lines.en: Something is eating your tomato leaves; I take note.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只青虫，比我还长。
lines.en: I fix on that green worm, longer than I am.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁在搬我的食物，我看见了。
lines.en: An ant is hauling off my food and I see it.

lines.zh: 我选中被咬穿的叶子，循着洞找。
lines.en: I pick a chewed-through leaf and follow the holes.

lines.zh: 那只蚜虫一动，我的触角就竖起来。
lines.en: The aphid shifts and my antennae stand up.

lines.zh: 有小虫靠近你养的宠物，我挡过去。
lines.en: A bug nears your pet and I step in front.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但我从不认错。
lines.en: The target is tiny, but I never mistake it.

lines.zh: 我飞到半空，从上面找一个目标。
lines.en: I lift off to pick a target from above.

lines.zh: 那股甜味是蚜虫留下的，我顺着走。
lines.en: The sweetness is aphid-made; I follow it.

lines.zh: 你的宠物在打喷嚏，我盯着它身边。
lines.en: Your pet sneezes and I watch the ground around it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那只飞虫，翅膀已经展开。
lines.en: The fly is locked in and my wings are already open.

lines.zh: 我停在那片叶的边缘，等它爬近。
lines.en: I stop at the leaf edge and wait for it to crawl near.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，我随时能扑过去。
lines.en: Wings half open, ready to pounce at any moment.

lines.zh: 我绕着目标转，找它没甲的那侧。
lines.en: I circle the target to find its unarmored side.

lines.zh: 它往叶脉躲，我堵在叶脉那头。
lines.en: It hides by the vein; I block that end.

lines.zh: 我的复眼一直跟着它，头都不动。
lines.en: My compound eyes track it without turning my head.

lines.zh: 我压住步子，让叶子别抖。
lines.en: I soften my steps so the leaf stays still.

lines.zh: 等它再啃一口，我就动。
lines.en: One more bite from it and I move.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，只差一点风。
lines.en: I have the distance worked out; only the wind is missing.

lines.zh: 我们几只瓢虫分头围住它。
lines.en: Several of us close in from different sides.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的前脚就抬起来。
lines.en: It stops, and my front legs come up.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，斑点朝上不动。
lines.en: I watch it, spots up and motionless.

lines.zh: 这一片叶上，它躲不掉。
lines.en: On this leaf, it has nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住蚜虫，汁水溅在叶上。
lines.en: I bite the aphid and its juice spatters the leaf.

lines.zh: 前脚按住，嘴再补一下。
lines.en: Front legs pin it and my mouth finishes the job.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，把它顶下叶子。
lines.en: I ram it once and knock it off the leaf.

lines.zh: 咬偏了，我只撕下一片蚜虫翅膀。
lines.en: I miss and only tear off an aphid's wing.

lines.zh: 打起来时，我的壳硬得像颗石子。
lines.en: In a fight my shell is as hard as a pebble.

lines.zh: 我咬住青虫的颈，它就不再扭。
lines.en: I bite the worm behind the head and it stops twisting.

lines.zh: 那一下很轻，但够它松口了。
lines.en: The hit is light, but enough to make it let go.

lines.zh: 我被它甩开，翻了个身又爬起来。
lines.en: It throws me off; I flip over and right myself.

lines.zh: 我不咬你的宠物，只咬害虫。
lines.en: I do not bite your pets, only the pests.

lines.zh: 咬完我擦擦嘴，红壳上沾着绿。
lines.en: Afterward I wipe my mouth, green on red shell.

lines.zh: 菜畦边多了一只红壳小虫。
lines.en: A small red-shelled bug appears by the beds.

lines.zh: 我从叶腋里爬出来，壳还软。
lines.en: I crawl from a leaf joint, shell still soft.

lines.zh: 这片花园虫子多，我留下来。
lines.en: This garden has plenty of bugs; I stay.

lines.zh: 我第一次张开壳，试着飞了一下。
lines.en: I open my shell for the first time and test a flight.

lines.zh: 晨露未干，我的斑点已经清楚。
lines.en: Dew is still wet and my spots already show.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇丛边出生，先闻了闻。
lines.en: Born by the mushroom patch, I sniff it first.

lines.zh: 这片叶子归我了，我在上面站定。
lines.en: This leaf is mine now; I take my stand.

lines.zh: 我数了数自己的斑点，七个。
lines.en: I count my own spots: seven.

lines.zh: 花还没开，我先在叶下等着。
lines.en: The flowers are closed; I wait beneath a leaf.

lines.zh: 我出现在这里，花园就少几只害虫。
lines.en: I arrive, and the garden has a few pests fewer.

lines.zh: 我的壳被烤得发烫，赶紧钻叶底。
lines.en: My shell grows hot, so I dive under a leaf.

lines.zh: 从叶尖掉到土上，壳替我挡了一下。
lines.en: I drop from the leaf tip and my shell takes the hit.

lines.zh: 掉进水里，我的脚划得很慢。
lines.en: In the water my legs paddle very slowly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连壳带叶掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me, shell and leaf together.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在叶上，离我半寸。
lines.en: An arrow pins the leaf half an inch from me.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，我的斑点开始发麻。
lines.en: Purple light sweeps past and my spots go numb.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我连壳都轻了。
lines.en: Two days hungry and even my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我的触角一直抖。
lines.en: The thunder is too close and my antennae keep shaking.

lines.zh: 叶子下面空了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The leaf gives way to nothing and I keep falling.
